## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL: Internal rotation, Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: mixed sector returns (Tech, Materials, Financials positive vs. broad sector weakness elsewhere) and concentrated top-performer mix (Leadership: Concentrated — 3/5 Technology), style mixed/no clear leadership.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Technology lead: CRM (1W: +22.69% | 1M: +33.80%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +29.05%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +5.13% | 1M: +19.98%) ABOVE TREND.  
Materials lead: FCX (1W: +10.11% | 1M: +30.72%) ABOVE TREND. Financials solid: V (1W: +3.81% | 1M: +3.16%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +0.76% | 1M: +2.76%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Consumer Discretionary weak: NKE (1W: -4.40% | 1M: -11.06%) BELOW TREND, TJX (1W: -4.60% | 1M: -16.70%) BELOW TREND.  
Energy showing cracks/short-term pullbacks: XOM (1W: -5.84% | 1M: +0.45%) CORRECTION, OXY (1W: -3.82% | 1M: +5.60%) CORRECTION. Utilities/Real Estate also under pressure.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: CRM (1W: +22.69% | 1M: +33.80%) ABOVE TREND, EL (1W: +10.46% | 1M: +26.25%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +10.11% | 1M: +30.72%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +9.52% | 1M: +21.87%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +29.05%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Technology), style mixed with a growth tilt.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: OXY (1W: -3.82% | 1M: +5.60%) CORRECTION, INTU (1W: -3.83% | 1M: +4.46%) CORRECTION, COP (1W: -3.98% | 1M: +10.44%) CORRECTION, NKE (1W: -4.40% | 1M: -11.06%) BELOW TREND, TJX (1W: -4.60% | 1M: -16.70%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Energy and Consumer Discretionary.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Strongest 1W movers: CRM (1W: +22.69% | 1M: +33.80%) ABOVE TREND, EL (1W: +10.46% | 1M: +26.25%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +10.11% | 1M: +30.72%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence flag: AAPL (1W: +1.05% | 1M: -6.90%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +4.63% | 1M: -2.48%) RECOVERY, UNH (1W: +2.65% | 1M: -6.07%) RECOVERY — tactical noise, watch for trend confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Tech is leading but internally mixed; notable ABOVE TREND leaders include MSFT (1W: +4.97% | 1M: +29.57%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +5.13% | 1M: +19.98%) ABOVE TREND, CRM (1W: +22.69% | 1M: +33.80%) ABOVE TREND — Sector breadth: Technology: 14/24 positive (internal rotation).

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials steady with broad ABOVE TREND pockets: V (1W: +3.81% | 1M: +3.16%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +3.12% | 1M: +5.04%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +0.76% | 1M: +2.76%) ABOVE TREND — Sector breadth: Financials: 11/20 positive.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare mixed; pockets of weakness and headline-driven moves: PFE (1W: +0.83% | 1M: +11.41%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +2.65% | 1M: -6.07%) RECOVERY, LLY (1W: -5.49% | 1M: -2.66%) BELOW TREND — Sector breadth: Healthcare: 7/17 positive.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
In a NEUTRAL regime favor select ABOVE TREND names and monitor divergence; favor CRM, MSFT, FCX and reduce exposure to Consumer Discretionary laggards (NKE, TJX, LOW) showing confirmed BELOW TREND. Style: mixed — selective exposure to Tech/Materials with attention to earnings/news-driven swings.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: CRM (1W: +22.69% | 1M: +33.80%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +10.11% | 1M: +30.72%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: LLY (1W: -5.49% | 1M: -2.66%) BELOW TREND, NKE (1W: -4.40% | 1M: -11.06%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -5.84% | 1M: +0.45%) CORRECTION.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Technology (Tech: 14/24 positive) and Materials (Materials: 8/11 positive) for momentum continuation.  
BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary (3/14 positive) and Energy (4/10 positive) for further downside risk.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA 900 resistance (ABOVE TREND continuation if cleared), MSFT 420 support (ABOVE TREND anchor), CRM 300 breakout to confirm momentum, NKE 70 breakdown would reinforce BELOW TREND trend.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
BA (+65): Headline on $131B F‑15 win; BA (1W: -2.42% | 1M: -1.93%) BELOW TREND — bullish news but price lagging, divergence to monitor.  
(Other top bullish names in the feed lack 1W/1M in today’s snapshot; watch BMY/ABT/GILD headlines when time-series available.)

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
NKE (-55): Headline on multi‑year lows; NKE (1W: -4.40% | 1M: -11.06%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed.  
INTU (-45): Intuit pressure from analyst cut; INTU (1W: -3.83% | 1M: +4.46%) CORRECTION — news aligns with 1W pullback, watch for follow-through.  
AAPL (-40): CEO change chatter; AAPL (1W: +1.05% | 1M: -6.90%) RECOVERY — news and price diverge, monitor for distribution.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with mixed style (growth tilt from Tech but no clear broad leadership). MSFT, NVDA, CRM ABOVE TREND and showing relative strength while NKE, TJX, LLY show confirmed BELOW TREND weakness. Key risk is the major divergence in large caps (AAPL/META/UNH RECOVERYs) and headline-driven moves (BA bullish news vs. BELOW TREND price) — watch for confirmation before shifting base allocations.
